title: Lula Bets on Social Spending Package as Flávio Bolsonaro Pushes Tactical Voting in Presidential Race Finale
detail: In the final stretch of Brazil's 2026 presidential race, President Lula is banking on a social spending package to shore up support, while Flávio Bolsonaro campaigns for 'voto útil' (tactical voting) to consolidate opposition votes ahead of the October election.
